item.title: Rekha Gupta v. AAP | Six URLs to be taken down in interim order
item.description: On 6 November, the Delhi High Court directed that six URLs carrying the AI-generated videos and images complained of be taken down, in an interim order in Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta's suit against the Aam Aadmi…
item.content:encoded:
On 6 November, the Delhi High Court directed that six URLs carrying the AI-generated videos and images complained of be taken down, in an interim order in Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta's suit against the Aam Aadmi Party.

The Court issued summons. The defendants are yet to be heard. The suit is listed next on 4 December.

item.title: AI deepfakes and political satire: update
item.description:
Smt. Rekha Gupta v. Aam Aadmi Party & Ors. (CS(OS) 1019/2026) (Delhi High Court)

The question: Whether AI-generated videos and images of the Delhi Chief Minister posted by a political party are protected satire or defamation.

Where it stands: Interim order of 6 November: six URLs directed to be taken down. Summons issued; the defendants are yet to be heard.

Next listed 2026-12-04
